## Fixes

- **Apple TV builds with ruby text.** The shared text renderer referenced `UIFont.TextStyle.largeTitle`, which UIKit does not provide on tvOS. The tvOS mapping now uses its supported first-level title style; iOS and macOS retain their existing mappings. Ruby annotations, highlighting and explicit font sizes remain available.
- **Regression coverage.** The ruby generation fixture now includes tvOS and a semantic large title, with Swift compilation against the tvOS simulator SDK when installed.

## Install

```sh
cargo binstall bern-cli@0.1.12
```

Apps pin the same version: `bern = "=0.1.12"`.

---

## 修正

- **Apple TV 注音渲染代码无法编译。** 共用文字渲染器引用了 tvOS UIKit 不提供的 `UIFont.TextStyle.largeTitle`。现在 tvOS 映射到系统支持的一级标题，iOS 与 macOS 的映射保持不变；注音、同步高亮和自定义字号仍然保留。
- **回归覆盖。** 注音生成用例新增 tvOS 和语义大标题，在安装对应 SDK 的环境中编译生成的 Swift 代码。

## 安装

```sh
cargo binstall bern-cli@0.1.12
```

应用固定同一版本：`bern = "=0.1.12"`。
